entries.answer:
The root cause is now confirmed. The code uses the bedrock-mantle endpoint (https://bedrock-mantle.us-east-1.api.aws/anthropic/v1/messages) but according to the official AWS docs, Claude Opus 4.6 is only available on the bedrock-runtime endpoint — the bedrock-mantle endpoint is not listed for this model. The fix is to switch to the correct bedrock-runtime endpoint and use AWS Signature V4 authentication (SigV4) — or, since the code uses a simple API key header pattern, switch to the Bedrock Mantle path format that does support API keys. Looking at the docs more carefully: the mantle URL for messages is https://bedrock-mantle.{region}.api.aws/v1 (not /anthropic/v1/messages), and the model ID anthropic.claude-opus-4-6-v1 is correct for bedrock-runtime.[1]

The fix: change BEDROCK_ENDPOINT to the correct bedrock-runtime URL and use the proper bedrock-runtime API format with AWS bearer token auth.
